issue_name: Unable to Log In With Account Credentials
description: Customers say they cannot get into their account or that their password is not accepted.
code_definition: cannot log in or sign up; password, verification or 'logged out' problems

description: Customers report being unable to choose songs, skip or return to previous tracks, rewind, or repeat playback without Premium. Some describe the free tier as having too many restrictions or say the app pushes them toward Premium.
code_definition: a feature is locked behind Premium or limited on the free tier (choosing a song, skips, rewind, repeat, turning shuffle off), or the app pressures users to buy Premium

description: Customers report that lyrics are absent or do not appear for some songs.
Customers say many songs are unavailable and that gospel music is limited.
code_definition: songs, artists, podcasts, videos or languages missing, removed or unavailable

description: Customers object to the recommendations they receive; one asks for them to stop, while another appears dissatisfied with the recommended music type.
code_definition: recommendations, discovery, search, generated mixes, unwanted suggested songs

issue_name: Offline Downloads Fail or Get Stuck
description: Customers say offline listening does not work and song downloads can remain stuck in the background.
code_definition: downloads fail, disappear or will not play offline

description: One customer calls the app bad because it supports LGBTQ people.
code_definition: political, religious, ethical or boycott statements that are not about how the product works

description: Customers express broad dissatisfaction with the app, describing it as bad, disappointing, or worse than before. They do not identify a specific feature or problem.
code_definition: general praise or criticism with no specific feature

description: A customer says they are unable to connect to the internet.
code_definition: 'no internet connection' errors, or playback via bluetooth, car, cast, speaker, watch, another device or a voice assistant

issue_name: App Crashes or Gets Stuck Loading
description: Customers say the app crashes when they try to open it or remains stuck on the loading or logo screen.
code_definition: app crashes, freezes, will not open or is stuck loading

description: The customer says music repeatedly stops halfway through playback.
code_definition: music or podcasts will not play, stop, pause, buffer, skip or restart by themselves

description: Customers report that ads are too frequent, sometimes playing after only one or two songs or instead of songs. One customer says the ads are too loud.
code_definition: too many, too long, too loud or badly timed ads

description: Customers report songs playing randomly within a playlist, music adjustment not working properly, and basic music-player features being unavailable.
code_definition: shuffle, skip, repeat, queue, playlist editing, autoplay or voice controls that work badly, NOT described as a Premium-only restriction

description: Customers say an update made the app feel unusable and dislike the new home screen. One customer says there is no clear way in settings to disable automatic playback.
code_definition: layout, navigation, redesigns, home screen, notifications, widgets, removed interface features
